title: Open Source Commons
summary: Build the public tools that make the next idea possible.
description: Great tools should belong to everyone. We support small teams maintaining open source libraries, developer infrastructure, and documentation that make the ecosystem easier to build in.
goals: An open source project with a clear public benefit
A practical milestone you can deliver in eight weeks
A short plan for keeping your work accessible

title: Local Climate Lab
summary: Turn a local climate challenge into a shared experiment.
description: From neighborhood heat maps to community energy projects, we fund grounded experiments that give people useful ways to respond to a changing climate.
goals: A specific community and a concrete climate challenge
A plan to share what you learn openly

title: Learning Without Borders
summary: Make useful knowledge easier to find, share, and build on.
description: Help people learn together. This grant supports open educational resources, community workshops, translations, and accessible learning experiences.
goals: A learning need you understand firsthand
Materials that others can use and adapt
A realistic plan for reaching your first learners

title: Community Signals
summary: Help communities make decisions with more voices in the room.
description: We support thoughtful approaches to collective decision making: accessible proposals, community research, and small governance tools that people actually want to use.
goals: A real community with a decision to make
A clear way to include less-heard voices
An experiment that can inform future decisions

title: Creative Public Spaces
summary: Create something that brings people and places together.
description: Support for community-led art, digital archives, and creative projects that make shared spaces more welcoming. Start small and invite others to take part.
goals: A creative idea rooted in a community
A shared output people can experience
An achievable budget and delivery plan
